title: A Postcards for the Glasshouse
author: Hazel Lockridge
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
